<html><head><link href="https://cdn.syncfusion.com/ej2/33.1.44/{{theme}}.css" rel="stylesheet">

<style>

    }
    #timeline-header h1 {
        color: #333;

    }
    #timeline-header p {
        color: #666;
        font-size: 16px;

    }
    #timeline-diagram {
        border: 1px solid #ddd;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: white;
    }
    #timeline-container .e-diagram-selector{
        stroke-width: 0;
    }

 font-family: 'History Timeline Font Icon' !important;
